requirement: Describe the main ROKHyT trial as a nationwide two-arm randomized parallel pilot comparing interactive hypertension text messaging plus usual kiosk information with usual kiosk information alone, with follow-up through 12 months.
acceptable_values: interactive text messaging plus usual care

evidence.text: The protocol separates the 140-participant trial from pretesting and vanguard phases and describes text messaging versus usual higi kiosk information with 3-, 6- and 12-month measurements.
The SAP compares interactive text messaging with current higi information and identifies 12 months as the primary endpoint.

requirement: Keep the 40-person message pretest, 10-person compressed vanguard and 140-person randomized trial analytically distinct; do not count pretest or vanguard participants in the main trial treatment comparison.
acceptable_values: main comparison excludes pretest and vanguard

evidence.text: The protocol defines three project phases: message pretesting, a 10-person vanguard and a 140-person trial.

requirement: Define the intervention as personalized, interactive educational and reminder text messages responsive to blood-pressure level, layered on usual kiosk information; define control as usual higi kiosk information without study text messages.
acceptable_values: usual kiosk information in both arms
no study text messages in control

evidence.text: The protocol describes personalized educational, interactive and reminder messages and contrasts them with information already displayed by higi kiosks.

requirement: Define trial eligibility from the higi user population using at least three systolic blood-pressure measurements above 140/90 mmHg in the previous 12 months, including one in the three months before invitation, age 18 to 85 years, weight below 300 pounds, mobile-phone access and consent.
acceptable_values: at least three prior elevated measurements

evidence.text: Table 3 and the enrollment narrative provide the kiosk-history, age, weight, cell-phone and consent criteria.

requirement: Implement 1:1 central randomization by the DCC, stratified by sex, age 18-55 versus 56-85 years and four US regions, and preserve the randomization strata in the primary adjusted analysis.

evidence.text: Randomization is 1:1 through the DCC and stratified by sex, two age categories and four country regions.
The planned Mantel-Haenszel relative risk is adjusted for stratification.

requirement: State masking by role and reconcile the registry's investigator and outcome-assessor masking with protocol operations that email participants their assigned group and deliver arm-specific text messages; do not claim participant masking.

evidence.text: The protocol says participants receive an email stating which group was assigned and describes visibly different messaging conditions.

requirement: Use the prospective pilot target of 140 randomized participants, 70 per group, justified as 10% of the planned full-scale trial for feasibility and a preliminary intervention signal; do not invent a confirmatory power calculation or substitute later actual enrollment as prospective evidence.

evidence.text: The protocol targets 70 per group and explains that this is 10% of the planned full-scale trial, intended to demonstrate feasibility and provide a preliminary signal.
The SAP repeats the randomized pilot target of 70 per group and says formal testing will not be done because the study is not powered for hypothesis testing.

requirement: Schedule main-trial kiosk blood-pressure assessments at baseline and 3, 6 and 12 months after randomization, instructing participants to take three readings about one minute apart at each follow-up measurement occasion.

evidence.text: The main trial uses baseline and 3-, 6- and 12-month kiosk measurements; follow-up instructions request three readings about one minute apart.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as participant-level blood-pressure control at 12 months, with control requiring systolic blood pressure below 140 mmHg and diastolic blood pressure below 90 mmHg; treat the SAP header's '<149/90' as an apparent typo only after source confirmation and specify how the three kiosk readings form the endpoint.

evidence.text: The intervention logic consistently uses control below 140/90 mmHg.
The introductory paragraph prints '<149/90' while the Aim 4 analysis later defines systolic below 140 and diastolic below 90; no within-occasion derivation is given.

requirement: For the 12-month blood-pressure-control endpoint, tabulate each arm's controlled proportion, report the intervention-minus-control absolute difference, and estimate a Mantel-Haenszel relative risk adjusted for the randomization strata.

evidence.text: Aim 4 specifies tabulation of proportions, their difference and a Mantel-Haenszel relative risk adjusted for stratification.

requirement: Treat intervention-effect analyses as estimation for a pilot rather than confirmatory hypothesis testing, and prespecify confidence levels and interval methods for proportions, absolute differences and adjusted relative risks without defining success from an unplanned p-value.

evidence.text: The protocol seeks a preliminary positive signal and says data summarization is the main approach because statistical significance is not expected.
The SAP says formal statistical testing will not be done because the pilot is not powered for hypothesis testing, but gives no confidence-interval specifications.

requirement: Define the primary analysis population from all randomized main-trial participants analyzed as assigned, and specify rules for participants who never receive messages, never return to a kiosk, withdraw, die or otherwise lack postrandomization data; do not replace randomized participants.

evidence.text: The protocol states that randomized people who die, drop out or are lost to follow-up will not be replaced but does not define an efficacy analysis set.

requirement: Define the primary estimand using the randomized main-trial population, assigned text-message versus usual-care conditions, 12-month blood-pressure control, absolute-difference and relative-risk contrasts, and explicit strategies for message nonreceipt, outside hypertension treatment, study withdrawal, death and missing kiosk measurement.

evidence.text: The protocol supplies assignment, follow-up and outside-provider context but no complete estimand or intercurrent-event strategy.
The SAP identifies the endpoint and contrasts but does not define the population or intercurrent-event handling.

requirement: Prespecify handling of missing 12-month control status, report availability and reasons by arm, distinguish no kiosk return from an observed uncontrolled reading, and provide a sensitivity analysis appropriate to the primary estimand rather than silently analyzing completers.

evidence.text: The protocol anticipates dropout and loss to follow-up and uses 12-month completion as a feasibility metric, but supplies no missing-outcome method.
The one-page SAP contains no missing-data rule.

requirement: Analyze blood-pressure control at 3 and 6 months as secondary time-specific binary outcomes using the same adjudicated control definition, reporting arm-specific denominators and estimates separately from the 12-month primary endpoint.

evidence.text: The protocol schedules blood-pressure measurements at 3 and 6 months in addition to 12 months.
The SAP calls for tabulating blood-pressure control at 3- and 6-month follow-up.

requirement: Treat 12-month systolic and diastolic blood pressure as separate continuous secondary outcomes, define their derivation from the three kiosk readings, adjust for corresponding baseline pressure and randomization strata, and report arm contrasts with confidence intervals.

evidence.text: The protocol collects repeated kiosk blood-pressure readings through 12 months but does not specify continuous-outcome models.

requirement: Define feasibility denominators before analysis: participation is the proportion of invited eligible people who consent and complete baseline requirements, while completion is the proportion randomized with the designated follow-up; reconcile the protocol's 12-month completion definition with registry wording that names randomization or Month 6.

evidence.text: The protocol defines participation using invited eligible people who consent and complete baseline questionnaire and BP, and defines completion using randomized participants completing 12-month BP; the release criterion is greater than 80% at 12 months.

requirement: Tabulate baseline demographic, socioeconomic, health-care-access, behavioral and blood-pressure characteristics by randomized arm and overall, using counts and percentages for categorical variables and transparent distribution summaries for continuous variables without significance testing of randomization balance.

evidence.text: The protocol lists demographic, socioeconomic, access, behavioral, medication and utilization variables collected at enrollment.
Aim 3 says demographic characteristics will be tabulated.

requirement: Summarize intervention delivery and engagement as process outcomes, including message delivery or response, return for prompted kiosk checks and health-care-provider contact where recorded, with participant-level denominators and no causal claim beyond the randomized intervention contrast.

evidence.text: The intervention elicits message responses, reminders, kiosk returns and reports of provider contact, but the SAP gives no process-outcome plan.

requirement: Define whether adverse events are collected for this low-risk behavioral pilot and, if collected, specify an exposed safety population and summarize participant incidence, seriousness, severity, relationship and discontinuation by received intervention; otherwise state and justify the absence of formal safety analysis.

evidence.text: The protocol describes the behavioral intervention and DSMB reporting but does not specify adverse-event collection or statistical safety summaries.

requirement: Before release, confirm from source history that the matching protocol and SAP dated 2019-04-15 are an unmodified prospective governing pair: they follow the 2019-03-06 study start and the protocol includes a vanguard phase, so exclude the family if the documents incorporated observed vanguard or randomized-trial outcomes.

evidence.text: The document identifies NCT03515681 and 15APR2019 and prospectively describes pretest, vanguard and trial phases.
The independent SAP shares the title, NCT and 15APR2019 protocol-version date and uses future-tense analysis language without results.

requirement: Keep the one-page reference SAP annotation-only: the model-visible protocol may expose the design, target, visits, control definition and descriptive pilot intent, but must not expose the reference-only Mantel-Haenszel relative-risk decision.

evidence.text: Full-page review found only a general data-summarization statement and no Mantel-Haenszel method.
The separate one-page SAP contains the stratification-adjusted Mantel-Haenszel relative-risk decision.
